event_signal_contract.value: float exactly 0.0 or 1.0; 0.0 is a valid false event value
event_signal_contract.validity: event_signal_valid must be boolean true; false is explicit unknown and rejected before model forward
event_signal_contract.producer: M10Environment._observation trigger_flags at the decision boundary
event_signal_contract.restored_branch: preserve the pre-action value; internal post-restore trigger flags cannot redefine the prefix

branches_labels_features: strict canonical order; permutations rejected, never silently relabeled
canonical_serialization: strict JSON object; ASCII escapes; sorted keys; compact separators; finite numbers; no tuple coercion
order: ascending legal global action index; candidate_order is rank in this canonical catalog
prefix_semantics: public decision context digest; distinct from full private branch snapshot prefix_sha256 in pair_identity
single_source: candidate_context + decision-before public entity IDs and effective legal mask
